verdict.rationale: PlanetScale explicitly documents non-interactive CLI SQL execution for agents/scripts (pscale sql), a full CLI for CI automation, a programmatic API, and service tokens specifically designed to authenticate the hosted MCP server and CLI in CI/headless-agent contexts. This directly addresses headless/CI automation as a first-class use case. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of CI usage specifically (community evidence covers general reliability but not CI/headless workflows directly).
